## D-flat gear seats and axial stack

The MHA-014 gear-land AF sizes are 8.763/5.842/2.921/1.460 mm, each
+0/−0.010 mm; their mating D-bores are +0.010/+0.020 mm over the nominal
AF. Check 0.01–0.03 mm flat clearance and 0.025–0.105 mm diametral
round slip clearance (`cad/scripts/cone_shaft_land_bands.py`,
`cad/scripts/gear_seat_fit.py`). Check the twenty touching
6.8887 ±0.025 mm cone gears as a stack at 137.774 ±0.20 mm, then push the
MHA-096 stack collar onto a 0.45 mm feeler on T006 and lock its set screw
on the D-flat, for 0.35–0.55 mm stack end play (`COLLAR_FEELER`,
`STACK_FLOAT`). Then hold the shaft's own end play at the cup screw to
0.05–0.25 mm (`SHAFT_END_PLAY`). The collar never touches the tip block:
at the printed limits at least 0.11 mm of air remains between them
(`TIP_COLLAR_WORST_AIR` in `cad/scripts/build_drive_train_assembly.py`;
`cad/scripts/cone_gear_stack.py`, `cad/scripts/cone_stack_end_play.py`).
